measurement_rule: Display-space comparison at 1024 by 1536. Disk edge estimated by strongest radial luminance fall near the predicted ellipse; texture and halo can shift this estimator. These are image checks, not recovered world radiometry.

visual_review.composition: Earth high in frame, dark sea, very low far-right land; no labels, Sun, beach, people or buildings.
visual_review.lighting: Warm reflected planet with internal variation and local halo; sparse warm glints increase toward foreground. No bright road to the horizon.
visual_review.waves: Long low swells and finer ripples retained approximately; AI changes small surface shapes and cannot certify the SWAN realization.
visual_review.atmosphere: Sky-only correction reduces some texture but residual mottling remains relative to the clear numerical sky.
visual_review.earth: Approximate geometry retained; AI modifies internal cloud markings and contrast. The measured texture remains available in the calculated reference.

decision: Use the 2048 by 3072 calculated view as the visibility-informed reference. Preserve both AI passes as illustration candidates, not exact observed or validated appearances.
open_conditions: Spatial colour and neural chromatic adaptation are not validated.
The historical cloud field is illustrative; no future weather forecast exists.
No human observation experiment or calibrated coastal Moon photograph was obtained.
The sea is the existing 4-sample-per-pixel render, with its saved Monte Carlo uncertainty; AI finish is not increased physical sample convergence.
